title: Chain Hoist & Monorail System Price Pakistan 2026 — Electric Chain Hoist, I-Beam Runway, CD1/MD1, FEM M3-M5, Festoon Cable, 18-Point Safety Checklist
summary_html: Complete buyer's guide to electric chain hoists and monorail runway systems in Pakistan 2026. Covers CD1 vs MD1 duty class (FEM M3–M5), I-beam runway sizing (IPE-160 to IPE-330), festoon cable design, PSQCA Factories Act compliance, VFD add-on energy saving, PKR price table 0.5T–10T, and an 18-point commissioning & safety checklist. Available from CNC Electric — Lahore, Karachi, Faisalabad.
